about.text: Quark that is heated after separation to inactivate all microorganisms, so it keeps without a cold chain. Stabilisers are added in the buffer tank before the final heating.

how.label: heat after draining
how.text: Stabilisers are added to the finished quark, which is then heat-treated in a plate, tubular or scraped-surface heat exchanger to keep longer.
